name: MotoWear OS Beeline App Patch
description: Morphe / ReVanced bytecode patches for the Official Beeline app (co.beeline)

patches.name: BypassBLEHardwareCheck
patches.description: Bypasses physical hardware signature validation in co.beeline BLE pairing, allowing instant pairing with MotoWear OS and custom BLE peripherals.

patches.name: UnlockBeelinePlusFeatures
patches.description: Unlocks Beeline Plus features including round-trip generation and premium map views.

patches.name: DisableSSLPinning
patches.description: Disables OkHttp CertificatePinner validation in co.beeline, allowing HTTPS login calls to api.beeline.co on custom signed APKs.
